selected_evidence.requirement: RabbitMQ cluster spans node1, node2, node3

selected_evidence.requirement: AMQP served over TLS using a cluster-created CA
selected_evidence.summary: CA generated on node1 (openssl req -x509), per-node server certs signed by it, rabbitmq.conf sets listeners.tcp=none and listeners.ssl.default=5671 with ssl_options pointing at the CA/server cert/key; cluster_status listeners show amqp/ssl on 5671 only

selected_evidence.requirement: Only clients presenting a certificate issued by the cluster CA are accepted
selected_evidence.summary: CA-signed client cert completes TLS handshake and successfully publishes/consumes an AMQPS message via pika; a self-signed (rogue) cert is rejected with tls_alert bad_certificate both in the RabbitMQ log and as a client-side SSLError, confirmed again after all node restarts

selected_evidence.requirement: Management interface reachable only from within the cluster
